title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 251 ]

blocks.text: It is often said that the Great Wall of China is the only human-made object that can be seen from space. This popular belief, however, is not true. The wall is very long, but in most places it is less than ten meters wide. It is also made of stone and earth that are similar in color to the land around it. From the International Space Station, about 400 kilometers above the Earth, it is extremely hard to see with the naked eye. In fact, Yang Liwei, China's first astronaut, said after his flight in 2003 that he could not see it. On the other hand, the lights of large cities are easy to see from space at night.
